title: Soccer prop write-up risk line is generic: same text for Under bets, cards and Yes/No scorer
steps: buildWriteup with sport=soccer, market=prop for Over goals, Under shots on goal 1.5, and a cards prop (evidence/PSOC-script.ts)
expected: Risk wording fits the bet: an Under benefits from an early substitution; cards risk is about discipline, not 'time to get there'; goalscorer risk should mention not starting (bet voids or loses depending on book).
actual: All soccer props get 'Risk: substitutions and rotation. A player taken off at the hour mark has less time to get there.' For an Under or a cards prop that sentence is backwards or meaningless. Nothing about lineup / not starting. Rest of text is clean (no undefined, no invented stats; consensus-only wording used).
